guideLayers.title: Local map layers
guideLayers.intro: These Front Royal samples show the detail currently generated at each local layer and the intended direction for deeper layers. Unavailable views enlarge the nearest generated tile.
guideLayers.overview: Countries, major lakes, and major rivers.
guideLayers.regions: First-level regions and major populated places.
guideLayers.regionalPlaces: More ranked cities, generalized urban areas, regions, water, and boundaries.
guideLayers.roads: Detailed water and primary road networks.
guideLayers.counties: States, counties, roads, and major settlements.
guideLayers.cities: Regional cities, secondary roads, and finer rivers.
guideLayers.towns: Smaller cities, towns, detailed roads, and water.
guideLayers.localRoutes: Parks, protected lands, denser towns, roads, railways, and waterways.
guideLayers.townLabels: Parks, protected lands, smaller towns, roads, railways, and waterways.
guideLayers.localWater: Finer placement of local roads, railways, waterways, parks, and ranked places.
guideLayers.neighborhoods: Finest generated view of roads, railways, water, parks, and local places.
guideLayers.fineRoutes: Finer secondary roads, ranked waterways, rail lines, and protected lands.
guideLayers.finestRoutes: Finest generated roads, including Main Streets, plus waterways, rail lines, parks, and ranked places.
guideLayers.rankedRoads: Ranked county, numbered, and long named roads supplement the existing map detail.
guideLayers.detailedRoads: A sparse overlay adds another tier of long municipal roads.
guideLayers.streets: Planned: named streets and local context.
guideLayers.blocks: Planned: blocks, paths, and detailed streets.
guideLayers.buildings: Planned: building footprints and service roads.
guideLayers.entrances: Planned: entrances, paths, and fine geometry.
guideLayers.precise: Planned: precise structures and pedestrian detail.
guideLayers.fallback: Currently displays the nearest generated tile.
